key_insight: RheOPT transfers geometry-conditioned transport structure from Newtonian simulations to improve non-Newtonian flow prediction with few target examples.
engineering_relevance: Reusing inexpensive Newtonian simulations can reduce the costly non-Newtonian training data needed for neural flow surrogates.
method: Pretrain a transformer-based neural operator on Newtonian flow simulations.
Fine-tune on a few non-Newtonian examples in matched geometries.
Evaluate normalization choices and use phase-insensitive diagnostics for oscillatory wakes.
evidence_signal: Across contraction and triangular-obstacle wake tests, pretraining improved few-shot predictions; in the contraction, four fine-tuning samples could match or exceed scratch training on 16 samples.
watch_item: Transfer was tested in matched geometries, and its benefit depended on normalization: RevIN was reliable, while Global normalization was dataset dependent.
paper_title: RheOPT: Few-Shot Non-Newtonian Flow Prediction via Newtonian Pretraining of RheOFormer
